goon 的力量永远不会因为硬件限制而停止！ 试图强制 Wan 在我的电脑上运行小于 16GB我向您展示了这个穴居人简单的工作流程，由 VRAM 和极慢的 AI GPU 组成。

重要：我不知道我在做什么，如果您知道如何加快此工作流程以及如何改进它，请立即告诉我！我正在使用全新的便携式安装。

要求：

我不确定要求，但我的设置最多使用 8.1GB 的 VRAM 和 16.2GB 的 RAM - 第一次加载后，需要近 28GB 的​​ RAM。

  • 最少为12GB 显存- 无论如何，没有 10GB 或 9GB 的 GPU。

  • 最少为28GB 内存- 相信我，它不适用于 16GB 或更少的内存。

特点：

  • 目前基本的 LoRa 支持。

所需型号：

  • 型号是Rapid Wan AIO 14B SFW - Q4_K_M /下载链接

  • 型号是 Rapid Wan AIO 14B NSFW - Q4_K_M /下载链接

  • 瓦埃是Wan 2.1 Vae - 默认/下载链接

  • 文本编码器剪辑 是umtt5-xxl-编码器-Q5_K_M /下载链接

读我：

  • 为了获得更多细节，最好运行 6 个步骤而不是 4 个步骤，或者使用详细信息 lora。

  • 负中文提示是必须的，否则结果会很糟糕，后面添加你自己的英文标签。

  • 我使用“禁止摄像机移动”而不是长句子。

  • “详细的动作”和其他质量标签似乎有效。

  • 据说NSFW版本虽然理解了更多概念，但在物理和精确动画方面比SFW差。但 SFW 对我来说看起来更糟糕。

  • 种子“42”为静态轻小说类动画提供了更好的效果。

  • 您可以简单地绕过保存视频和洛拉如果需要加载。

表现：

  • 在 800x400 分辨率下，平均时间为 3-6 分钟 4 秒。

  • 700x500 分辨率下平均 3-6 分钟 5 秒。

  • 分辨率为 400x400 时平均为 3 分钟 5 秒。

  • 200x250 分辨率下 5 秒的平均时间为 56 秒。

  • 在 416x512 分辨率下，6 个步骤平均耗时约 2 分钟，最快。

性能提示：

  • 如果您可以设置 Sage Attention，您将获得更快的性能。

  • SSD/NVME将更适合RAM文件管理。我的运行在硬盘上，是的。

  • 我的 RAM 模块有扰频，期望有更好的性能。

问题：由于奇怪的原因，如果迭代速度高于 100it/s，gen 需要 8-14 分钟。中断并重新启动以正常速度。

最佳实践：

无需高级提示，直接描述，就像使用 Flux 或 SDXL 一样。

  • 描述第一帧，描述下一个要执行的动作+细节+形容词，重复，重复；质量标签、负面标签

  • [场景描绘了一个害怕的动漫女孩，她转身面对镜头，她并拢双腿，触摸自己的胸部；镜头移得更远，高清，荒诞，动作细致]

  • 【场景描绘了一位戴着眼罩的动漫女孩，她摘下眼罩，将其贴近胸口，眼神空洞；没有摄像机运动，高分辨率，荒谬，详细的运动]

  • [赤壁动漫女孩的3D模型拿着两把枪，她用枪指着周围，头发随风摇曳，她看着镜头]

o.en:
The power of goon can't never be stopped by hardware limitations! In an attempt to force Wan to run on my pc havingless than 16GBof VRAM and extremely slow AI GPU I present with you with this caveman easy workflow.

I M P O R T A N T:I have no idea what I'm doing, if you know how to speed this workflow up and how to improve it, let me know right away!I'm using a fresh portable installation.

Requirements:

I'm not sure about the requirements, but my setup is using max of 8.1GB of VRAM and 16.2GB of RAM - After the first load, which requires nearly 28GB of RAM.

  • Minimum of12GB of VRAM- There's no GPU with 10GB or 9GB anyways.

  • Minimum of28GB of RAM- It will not work with 16GB or less, trust me.

Features:

  • Basic LoRa Support for now.

Models Needed:

  • ModelisRapid Wan AIO 14B SFW - Q4_K_M /Download Link

  • Modelis Rapid Wan AIO 14B NSFW - Q4_K_M /Download Link

  • VaeisWan 2.1 Vae - Default /Download Link

  • Text Encoder Clip isumtt5-xxl-encoder - Q5_K_M /Download Link

Read Me:

  • It is better to run 6 steps rather than 4 for more details, or use a detailer lora.

  • Negative chinese prompt is obligatory, otherwise results will be shit, add your own english tags after.

  • I use "No camera movement" instead of long sentences.

  • "Detailed movement" and other quality tags seems to work.

  • It is said that NSFW version is worse than SFW at physics and accurate animation despite understanding more concepts. But SFW looks much worse for me.

  • Seed "42" gives better results for static light novel-like animations.

  • You can simply bypassSave VideoandLoRaloading if needed.

Performance:

  • Average of 3-6 minutes for 4 seconds at 800x400 resolution.

  • Average of 3-6 minutes for 5 seconds at 700x500 resolution.

  • Average of 3 minutes for 5 seconds at 400x400 resolution.

  • Average of 56 seconds for 5 seconds at 200x250 resolution.

  • Average of ~2 minutes at 416x512 resolution at 6 steps, fastest.

Performance Tips:

  • If you can set up Sage Attention you will have extremely faster performance.

  • SSD/NVME will be better for RAM file management. Mine is running on HDD, yes.

  • My RAM modules have scrambled frequencies, expect better performance.

Issues:For weird reasons, if iterations are above 100it/s, gen takes 8-14 minutes. Interrupt and start it again for normal speed.

Best Practices:

No advanced prompt needed, straight describe as if using Flux or SDXL.

  • describe first frame, describe next action to perform+details+adjectives, repeat, repeat; quality tags, negative tags

  • [the scene despicts a scared anime girl, she turns to face the camera, she closes her legs and touches her own chest; the camera moves farther away, highres, absurdres, detailed movements]

  • [the scene despicts a anime girl wearing a blindfold, she removes the blindfold, holding it close to her chest, her eyes are empty; no camera movement, highres, absurdres, detailed movements]

  • [a 3d model of chibi anime girl is holding two guns, she points the gun around while her hair sways with the wind, she looks at the camera]
